**Not as a recorded loss event, but small-scale loss did show up in 2024.**

- **No qualifying event in 2024:** The analysis found no tree-cover loss event of at least 0.5 ha in 2024. The only counted event was in 2023: 0.7 ha (1.2% of the 58.1 ha property). It was corroborated, since the JRC 2020 map shows that area was forest and later years were observed.
